en.title: Squid Game Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk Hints at More Games, Teases Gi-hun's Return
en.summary: The mastermind behind Netflix's global sensation, **Hwang Dong-hyuk**, has reignited speculation about the future of the **Squid Game** universe. While a definitive third season remains uncertain, Hwang's latest comments suggest the games might not be over for good.
en.body:
The question on every **Squid Game** fan's mind has always been: Will the games return? Creator **Hwang Dong-hyuk**, who brought the world the brutal, thought-provoking survival drama, has offered tantalizing hints that the answer might be a resounding yes.

While **Hwang** previously confirmed that the series, as it stood, was slated to conclude with a third season in 2025, his recent statements suggest the door to the deadly playground isn't entirely shut. He has been in discussions with Netflix regarding not just the potential for a third season, but also the possibility of exploring other narrative avenues within the **Squid Game** lore. It's a delicate balance for **Hwang**, who famously spent nearly a decade developing the first season, a testament to his meticulous creative process. The immense global success of **Squid Game** certainly validated Netflix's significant investment in Korean content, proving that international stories can capture a worldwide audience.

## The Stakes for Gi-hun

For fans invested in the fate of Seong Gi-hun, the protagonist's journey is far from over. **Hwang Dong-hyuk** has explicitly stated that Gi-hun will indeed return. "Gi-Hun will come back and he will do something for the world," **Hwang** confirmed, hinting at a pivotal role for the character in any future installments. This implies that the narrative will continue to explore the consequences of his participation in the games and his subsequent awakening. The question remains how this will manifest – will it be another season of the deadly competition, or a different form of exploration within the universe? The creator has also alluded to a potential spin-off series, which could delve into unseen aspects of the **Squid Game** narrative, further expanding the universe's reach.

## What's Next for the Franchise

The immediate focus for **Hwang** and Netflix appears to be solidifying plans for the next chapter, whether that be a direct continuation or a related project. While specific details and release windows for any new **Squid Game** content have not yet been announced, the creator's willingness to engage with these possibilities indicates a strong desire to continue building upon the phenomenon he created. Fans are eagerly awaiting further news, hoping for another dose of the compelling storytelling that made **Squid Game** a global cultural touchstone.
